answer: Each identity must lock a river-sourced stake of 25 POA in an escrow whose release schedule stretches by 6 epochs for every other identity sharing its onyx-derived funding root, so a farm of n fakes ties up 25n POA for about 6n(n-1)/2 extra epochs.
